reviews.title: Fits perfectly, nice weight and good construction
reviews.body: Unlike my previous shower curtain liner these feature nice, secure metal loops at the top for hanging on the curtain hooks. This prevents tear-out from pulling the curtain liner back which was a problem on the previous one. The plastic feels just heavy enough to be sturdy without being inflexible. It hangs properly and slides easily. The magnets help with hanging straight due to the weight and make the curtain move nicely. My tub is fiberglass so the magnets serve no other purpose. I find the width and length to be perfect and of course the liner does keep the water in the shower and not on the external curtain. It is not too still nor too flimsy which is great at this low cost. It probably could be washed in the laundry, but when it gets to the point of needing this treatment I'll simply by another since the cost is so low.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 23 May 2026

features: Qualified: High quality PEVA shower curtain liner is a good choice for the person who requires light weight liner for bathtub.Convenient fold, simple and low cost, the liner plays a function to better hold back water in a shower.
*Water Proof: The liner has the advantage of plastic material properties like PVC free. It performs water proof well, allowing form water beads on the surface and easy to clean with a damp cloth
*Encased magnets: Comes with 3 magnets at the bottom, especially good for cast/iron bathtub, in respect that it's easy to stick to the tub and keep the liner from blowing or clinging to body
*Durable: Reinforced top header along with 12 rust proof metal grommets helps the shower curtain liner long-lasting use
*72 inch width by 72 inch height, standard size is suitable for your bathroom
